name: Ontology Registry Index-Meta Sync
description: Implement Phase 4 registry-service index-meta sync for active ontology allocations: product prefix DAG materialization, sum leaf/segment sidecar reporting, schema version writes, idempotency, drift handling, service integration, tests, and docs updates.

userStories.title: Define Index-Meta Sync Adapter Boundary
userStories.description: As a registry-service developer, I want a sync adapter boundary so that `OntologyRegistryService` can materialize active allocations without embedding index-meta details in unrelated service logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a sync adapter interface or internal helper under `packages/registry-service/src/modules/ontology/` or a similarly scoped module.
Define sync input bundle shape containing allocation, namespace, taxonomy, axes, and segments.
Define sync report shape for materialized records, no-op idempotent records, repaired records, collisions, and deferred/unsupported sum segment semantics.
Adapter depends on index-meta `PrefixRegistry` and schema version store APIs, not raw index-meta tables.
Adapter does not add REST routes or CLI commands.
Existing deferred report shape from Phase 3 remains source-compatible where possible.

userStories.title: Collect Active Allocation Sync Bundle
userStories.description: As a registry-service developer, I want the service to collect a complete active allocation bundle so that sync does not infer ontology state from index-meta.
acceptanceCriteria: Method rejects missing allocation and non-active allocation as before.
Method loads the allocation namespace, taxonomy, required axes, and segments from the store.
Missing namespace, taxonomy, axis, or segment data returns structured sync precondition errors.

userStories.title: Materialize Product Allocation Prefixes
userStories.description: As an ontology registry operator, I want product allocations materialized into index-meta prefix records so that composite decode can use existing prefix DAG behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: For each taxonomy axis, derive a deterministic axis leaf prefix name.
Register each axis leaf prefix/version with capacity matching the axis registration.
Register the allocation prefix/version as a composite prefix with refs in taxonomy `axisIds` order.
Parent capacity equals allocation capacity, allocation address size, and product of ref capacities.
Product segment shape is checked before writing the parent record.
Re-running the same sync is idempotent.
Existing same prefix/version with different capacity or refs fails without overwriting.

userStories.title: Write Schema Version Records
userStories.description: As an index-meta consumer, I want schema version rows created alongside prefix registry rows so that prefix registry and schema version capacity stay aligned.
acceptanceCriteria: Sync writes schema version records for every materialized axis leaf prefix.
Sync writes a schema version record for the allocation prefix.
Schema version capacity matches prefix registry capacity for every written prefix.
Existing matching schema version is treated as idempotent no-op.
Existing mismatched schema version capacity is reported as capacity drift and not overwritten.
Partial prefix/schema records are repaired only if existing records match intended allocation shape.

userStories.title: Materialize Sum Allocation as Leaf with Segment Sidecar
userStories.description: As an ontology registry operator, I want sum allocations handled safely even though index-meta has no segment model yet.
acceptanceCriteria: Sum allocation sync registers allocation prefix/version as a leaf prefix with capacity equal to allocation capacity.
Sync writes matching schema version record for the sum allocation prefix.
Sync does not write `prefix_ref` rows for sum segments.
Sync report includes segment sidecar metadata with range and consumes data.
Segment sidecar coverage is validated for range containment, no overlap, and total coverage policy chosen by the handoff spec.
Re-running the same sum allocation sync is idempotent.

userStories.title: Add Sync Collision and Drift Tests
userStories.description: As a registry-service maintainer, I want tests for sync collisions and drift so that index-meta records are not silently overwritten.
acceptanceCriteria: Test product prefix capacity drift fails without overwrite.
Test product refs drift fails without overwrite.
Test schema version capacity drift fails without overwrite.
Test partial matching records can be completed when safe.
Test partial mismatched records fail without overwrite.

userStories.title: Replace Deferred Sync Report in Service
userStories.description: As a registry-service consumer, I want `syncToPrefixRegistry()` to perform real sync while preserving Phase 3 preconditions.
acceptanceCriteria: `OntologyRegistryService.syncToPrefixRegistry()` calls the sync adapter for active allocations.
Missing and non-active allocation errors remain compatible with Phase 3.
Successful report has `syncStatus` representing real sync result, not only `"deferred"`.
Method does not activate allocations; it only syncs already-active allocations.
Existing Phase 3 service tests are updated without weakening precondition coverage.

userStories.title: Add Activation Smoke-Level Sync Checks
userStories.description: As a future activation smoke implementer, I want minimum post-sync checks available so Phase 5 can prove end-to-end activation without reimplementing sync validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add helper or report fields that confirm prefix registry record exists after sync.
Add helper or report fields that confirm schema version capacity exists after sync.
For product allocations, verify `getShape(prefix, versionId)` equals ordered axis capacities.
For product allocations, verify last valid address index is in range and capacity index is out of range if a resolver helper exists.
For sum allocations, verify reported segment sidecar covers the allocation according to the selected sum policy.
These checks do not implement full Phase 5 activation helper.

userStories.title: Reflect Phase 4 Completion in Docs and TODO
userStories.description: As an ontology documentation maintainer, I want Phase 4 completion reflected in specs and TODO so Phase 5 activation smoke starts from stable sync behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `operational-ontology-registry-allocation.todo.md` to mark Phase 4 index-meta sync items complete or explicitly deferred.
Update `operational-ontology-registry-allocation.spec.md` to summarize sync adapter, product mapping, sum sidecar policy, idempotency, and drift behavior.
Update `operational-ontology-index-meta-sync-handoff.spec.md` with implementation refinements and real report shape.
Keep Phase 5 activation smoke items open.
Update `tasks/prd-ontology-registry-allocation-lifecycle-master.md` with the Phase 5 execution PRD path if it is created.
